source.title: BMW Z3 Owner's Manual
source.notes: Archived copy of the BMW AG owner manual. Specifications below are limited to statements explicitly present in the manual.

items.name: Engine oil & filter
items.fluid_spec: BMW-approved engine oil; SAE 5W-40 or 5W-30. The manual permits API SH or higher synthetic oil only when approved BMW oils are unavailable for topping up.
items.notes: BMW's Maintenance System determines oil service from actual vehicle loads. The owner manual does not state one universal fixed oil-change mileage interval.

items.name: Coolant
items.fluid_spec: BMW-approved nitrite- and amino-free extended-duty antifreeze with corrosion inhibitor for aluminum radiator cores; maintain a 50:50 coolant/water mixture.
items.capacity: 11.1 US qt (10.5 L) including heater circuit
items.notes: The owner manual says to replace coolant regularly and refers to the Service and Warranty Information booklet for the service interval; no fixed interval is inferred here.
